Their values are:
  adjustment_1 = 2
  adjustment_2 = 232
  adjustment_3 = -7990
The net exposure is the product of all the adjustments.
Compute the net exposure as an exact signed integer.

---

- 464 × 8000 = 3,712,000  
- But 7990 is 8000 − 10, so:  
  464 × 7990 = 464 × (8000 − 10) = 3,712,000 − 4,640 = 3,707,360
